text:
Alex K: quick Q — I have trace id 9f1b2c3d4e5f and need the raw request lines (headers/body). Console trace view links to spans but console logs hide req_id. Where to look? :wave:
Maria S: if it's an edge request, check logs for proxy pods with stern or the Logs UI. Which cluster?
Alex K: prod cluster (us-west1)
Ryan P: easiest: copy trace id -> open Traces UI -> click a span for "edge-proxy" -> "Open logs for this span" (link). If that doesn't show request_id, run stern on the edge pod:
```
stern -n prod edge-proxy -c proxy --since 5m | rg 9f1b2c3d
```
Ellie: also try raw logs query in Console -> Logs: query `attributes.request_id:"9f1b2c3d"` or `json.payload.request_id:"9f1b2c3d"` depending on ingestion. If Console collapses fields, add `| parse` to unnest.
Maria S: if you only have trace id, map to span id via traces API:
```
curl -s "https://observability.internal/api/traces/9f1b2c3d" | jq '.spans[] | select(.name=="edge-proxy") | .span_id'
```
then grep that span_id in logs (some proxies log span id as `span=` attr).
Alex K: I ran stern, found lines but they're compacted; how to expand JSON?
Ryan P: use `jq -R -c 'fromjson? // . ' ` trick or set `--output json` for your logging tool. Example:
```
stern -n prod edge-proxy -c proxy --since 5m | jq -R 'fromjson? | .message // .'
```
Ellie: FYI if you see `x-request-ref` header instead of request_id, search for that header value. Also some old edge versions used `req_ref`.
ops-bot: deploy-prod edge-proxy v4.8.1 succeeded — no rollbacks :tada:
Alex K: got it, found payload and headers. thanks everyone :+1:
Maria S: leaving a tiny HOWTO in the observability docs later — will link here when done.
Alex K: great, appreciate it.
